name: Macadamia Milk
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's naturally low FODMAP and free from common SIBO triggers like inulin or excess fiber.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels to avoid added inulin, chicory root, or high FODMAP sweeteners
Choose unsweetened varieties or those sweetened with maple syrup in small amounts
Store opened cartons in refrigerator and use within 7-10 days
Shake well before using as natural separation occurs
nutritionalHighlights: Lower in protein compared to dairy milk
Often fortified with calcium and vitamin D
